value: In Shattrath, Khadgar receives Alturus’s account and sees a familiar problem in it. Karazhan cannot simply be forced open; the Master’s Key once held that power, and he knows the key’s history. He will help restore it, though the next stages will cross Outland’s changed strongholds. The meeting begins the fragment quest line. It is a new undertaking prompted by Alturus’s report, not proof that the Violet Eye has already learned what happened inside the tower.
